comparisonScope: Same shared tight-compiled runner per fixture and workload; v20 anchor mode keeps its exact guard and historical first-batch retention counts
limitations: Shared tight-compiled aliases are used for anchor and tight modes; this is not a separately compiled historical v20 runner setup comparison.
This bounded checkpoint measures four pre-existing mirror fixtures at 128 paths per run. No larger-path-load measurements or performance claim are included.

CPU shadow is constructed independently per fixture/workload and audited on every measured or warmup run. Renderer time excludes CPU shadow construction and subsequent audits; it includes selective replay and readbacks, all separately reported.
Renderer dispatch/submit/wait counters are host wall times, not GPU timestamp queries.
Descriptive native software-adapter timing only; no physical-GPU, browser or statistical speed claim.
